art_direction.concept: A recognisable faceless ivory figure moves from scattered choices to one composed, useful system: بروتوكول التحول. Confidence comes from controlled gestures, legible demonstrations and deliberate pacing.
art_direction.visual_language: Matte near-black space, warm restrained gold accents, soft ivory figure, original product identity. Use one coherent lighting direction, generous negative space and consistent depth; avoid generic shiny gold spectacle.
art_direction.sequence: Establish character and problem immediately; reveal the original product within the opening quarter; demonstrate actual training and recipe content; resolve into a quiet price-and-action composition.
art_direction.motion: Give each gesture a clear cause and result. A figure gesture can organize a list, a gold line can become a frame for a real app screen, and a product edge can motivate the next reveal. Use brief anticipation, eased travel and a settled reading hold.
art_direction.typography: Protect Arabic as a stable foreground reading layer with correct RTL shaping, concise phrases and consistent hierarchy. Move supporting graphics around the text; never distort, scramble, crop or perspective-warp the reading copy.
art_direction.sound: Preserve the source narration character and pacing. No music. Sparse purposeful effects should confirm meaningful actions without competing with speech.

acceptance_checks.check: The frozen final contains the same recognisable faceless white/ivory character premise, with coherent anatomy, stable silhouette and no unintended facial detail.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Opening, middle and final full-frame stills plus motion samples around gestures.

acceptance_checks.check: Original product identity appears by the opening quarter; real app/product demonstrations are legible, truthful and marked as demonstration when appropriate.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Timestamped reveal frame, actual demonstration frames and asset provenance.

acceptance_checks.check: Arabic captions and key claims remain correctly shaped, visually uncluttered and inside protected mobile safe areas throughout entrances, holds and exits; foreground character/UI never covers them.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Full-resolution frames at each caption hold and worst overlap point, with safe-area overlay or bounds evidence.

acceptance_checks.check: Final CTA holds a settled composition for at least three seconds with بروتوكول التحول, 15.99 ر.س and a clear purchase direction; no late visual event steals attention.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Final uninterrupted segment and start/end timestamps.

acceptance_checks.check: Black/gold/ivory palette, material finish, spacing and light remain consistent; original logos and covers are undistorted, and gold highlights preserve text contrast.
acceptance_checks.evidence: A timestamped contact sheet covering every scene.

acceptance_checks.check: Transitions communicate progression between problem, product and proof. Menus/lists visibly settle before reading, and each shot has one dominant focal point.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Continuous transition samples and a scene timing map.

acceptance_checks.check: Delivery is 1080x1920 at true 60 fps and the final player/download target resolves to the reviewed frozen artifact.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Media probe, frame cadence evidence, file digest and delivered link.

limitations: No final candidate has been reviewed and no approval is cast.
Naturalness of narration cannot be established through human listening in this capability set; ASR and audio measurements alone are insufficient.
Editorial visual quality is assessable; sales performance is not established by this review.
Store administration, payments, software infrastructure and unrelated legal/security changes are outside this art-direction scope.
